title: fix(setup): first-run admin polish — nav pin, widget service-gate, i18n, settings PUT envelope
body:
## What

First-run system-administration polish found by dogfooding the Setup app (系统设置) as a brand-new admin standing up the platform. Fixes the bounded items; the larger gaps stay tracked in #2246.

| Area | Fix |
|------|-----|
| **Discoverability** | Pin **Localization** + **Company** in the Setup sidebar Configuration group — both are registered `service-settings` manifests (the two lowest-`order` Workspace settings) but were reachable only via the "All Settings" hub. |
| **Coherence** | Tag `widget_organizations` with `requiresService: 'org-scoping'` and **extend the ADR-0057 D10 server-side visibility gate to dashboard widgets** (`rest-server`) — single-tenant runtimes no longer render an orphan "Organizations" KPI (matching the already-hidden org nav entries). |
| **i18n** | Translate nav labels Cloud Connection → 云连接, Datasources → 数据源, Capabilities → 能力; add missing zh `help` for the Localization settings fields. |
| **API DX** | `PUT /api/settings/:ns` now also accepts the `{ values: { … } }` envelope that `GET` returns (symmetry; was a confusing `UNKNOWN_KEY`). |

## Why

A real admin's first hour hit these: the two most important first-run settings (company identity, locale) weren't in the sidebar; the overview dangled an "Organizations: 0" KPI with no way to act on it; several nav/help strings leaked English in a zh session; and reading then writing a setting back failed.

The widget gate is the one non-trivial change: widget visibility was enforced **client-side only** (the console honors `requiresObject` but not `requiresService`), whereas ADR-0057 D10 makes the **server** the authoritative gate ("client filtering is courtesy"). This adds the missing server-side `requiresService` enforcement for widgets, mirroring the existing app-nav gate.

## Verification

- Builds green: `platform-objects`, `service-settings`, `rest` (incl. DTS typecheck).
- Tests: `service-settings` **128** (+2), `rest` **133** (+6 dashboard-gate tests).
- **Browser-verified** on `examples/app-showcase` (`objectstack dev`, zh session): Localization & Company pages reachable from the sidebar; Organizations KPI gone from the overview; 云连接 / 能力 shown; `PUT {values:{…}}` → 200.

Relates to #2246.
